infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyHealthNest uses your camera to scan prescriptions and medical reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MyHealthNest lets you select medical documents from your photo library.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: MyHealthNest uses Face ID to protect your private medical vault.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MyHealthNest lets you import an emergency contact from your address book.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MyHealthNest to access your camera to scan medical documents.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MyHealthNest to select medical reports from your photos.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow MyHealthNest to use Face ID to unlock your medical vault.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow MyHealthNest to import an emergency contact.
